# data/scenarios.csv registers each axis with its ONE published alternative; this file
# registers the finer question an alternative can leave open. Configuration S observes
# 11.97 Mt of dung cake in households against a 58.69 Mt supply-side diversion
# conservation cannot say where the other 46.72 Mt went -- but each candidate destination
# national reading. Each variant prices exactly one destination
# assigned (a schema test enforces that no such column exists)
# consequences are published in outputs/national_dung_variants.csv by report/dung_variants.py.
# pricing_method is the machinery contract: every variant is priced by REUSING the sector
# engines on copies or by arithmetic over already-published outputs -- never by a second
